name: bay-coast-watch
description: Map dashboard for El Niño, tides, coastal water and weather around the San Francisco Bay Area, built on public NOAA / NWS data. Static site + Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev -c workers/site/wrangler.jsonc -c workers/data/wrangler.jsonc --test-scheduled
scripts.check: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c workers/data/wrangler.jsonc --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry/data && wrangler deploy -c workers/site/wrangler.jsonc --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry/site
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c workers/site/wrangler.jsonc
